name: Zurich City Tour
overview: Zurich city tours showcase Switzerland's largest city and global financial hub, combining medieval Old Town charm with modern urban sophistication. Explore historic churches, luxury shopping streets, and beautiful lake vistas.
history: Zurich's history spans over 2,000 years, from Roman settlement Turicum to medieval guild city to modern banking center. The city perfectly balances preservation of its historic core with cutting-edge architecture and cultural innovation.
highlights: Old Town (Altstadt) with medieval guildhalls and cobblestone streets
Bahnhofstrasse - world's most expensive shopping street
Lake Zurich waterfront with panoramic Alpine views
Grossmünster twin towers - Protestant cathedral with city views
Fraumünster Church with famous Chagall stained glass windows
Swiss National Museum showcasing Swiss cultural history
University of Zurich and ETH Zurich campuses
Niederdorf district with restaurants, bars, and boutiques
tips: Walking tours cover Old Town efficiently. Tram day passes provide easy city navigation. Lake cruises offer different perspective. Swiss museums are often closed Mondays. Summer evening lake swimming is popular with locals.
